cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(swift_cpp_demo LANGUAGES CXX Swift)

find_package(lunasvg REQUIRED)

add_executable(demo main.swift)

target_link_libraries(demo PRIVATE
  lunasvg::lunasvg
)

# Module map generated by conanfile.py's generate() for the Swift-unaware lunasvg headers.
get_filename_component(_conan_generators_dir "${CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE}" DIRECTORY)

# CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD comes from Conan's CMakeToolchain, derived from the profile's
# compiler.cppstd, so this doesn't drift from what lunasvg itself was built with.
target_compile_options(demo PRIVATE
  "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-cxx-interoperability-mode=default>"
  "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:SHELL:-Xcc -std=c++${CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD}>"
  "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:SHELL:-Xcc -fmodule-map-file=${_conan_generators_dir}/shim/lunasvg.modulemap>"
)
